_note: The widget data sources (plan 4.2, D79): what a binding {{source.field}} can read. tools/widget_check.py checks bindings against it; tools/gen_sources.py makes shell/widgethost/SourceCatalog.js from it. A field's type: text, number, fraction (0 to 1, for progress), boolean, list (of items with the fields in `item`; a listRow that binds into one repeats per item), or open (any path below it: the source's own JSON). A source's options go in the widget's `sources` object (widgets/spec.schema.json).

clock.description: The time and date, updated every minute (every second while `seconds` is bound).

time.description: The time in the locale's short format, e.g. 14:05.

date.description: Weekday, month and day, e.g. Tue, Nov 3.

dayProgress.description: How much of the day has passed.

status.description: Charging, Discharging, Full or Not charging.

timeLeft.description: Time to full or to empty, e.g. 2 h 10 min; empty when unknown.

system.description: Processor and memory use, read every 2 seconds.

uptime.description: Time since start, e.g. 3 h 12 min.

load.description: Load average over one minute, e.g. 0.52.

countdown.description: Time left until a moment (options: target, and from for the fractions).

text.description: What is left, e.g. 3 days 4 h, or Now.

remaining.description: Share of the time from `from` to `target` still left (0 without `from`).

progress.description: Share of the time from `from` to `target` gone (1 without `from` once done).

media.description: What is playing (MPRIS): the player that is playing, or else the first one.

art.description: Album art, a URL for heroImage.

weather.description: Current weather from Open-Meteo (no key), every 30 minutes; the place from the options or from Settings > Widgets.

wind.description: Wind speed with its unit, e.g. 12 km/h.

symbol.description: A Material Symbols name for the condition, e.g. partly_cloudy_day.

calendar.description: Upcoming events from an .ics file or a folder of them (vdirsyncer's); single events only, repeats are not expanded.

events.description: The next events, soonest first, at most 8.

date.description: Its day, e.g. Thu, Nov 5, or Today.

time.description: Its start time, or All day.

next.description: The next event's title, or No events.

count.description: How many events are in the coming days.

http.description: A JSON document from a URL that Settings > Widgets allows (option url; every `every` seconds, at least 60). Its fields are read below http, e.g. {{http.rates.EUR}}.

files.description: A text file (option path; read again when it changes).

text.description: The whole text, up to 2000 characters.

json.description: The file's JSON, when it is JSON, e.g. {{files.json.total}}.
